items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: he liked working with Muggsy he liked that record he made with Muggsy

ctx.x: did he ever talk to you about not using a trumpet? I mean did he seem to prefer that or just the fact that he had trouble getting a good trumpet?

yeah he had trouble getting a good trumpet player he didn't like the way most trumpet players played because it got in his way yeah you know he liked working with Muggsy he liked that record he made with Muggsy

well it's funny down here too at the time they had that Esquire concert about 1945 I guess in January of 45 went all over the country they had some rehearsals here I know they had a couple of local bands I think Sharky's band maybe George Lewis or two or three other local bands here played and they told that when Louis Armstrong was leader of this all-star group had been selected by Esquire partly they had gotten votes there at least Sidney came down to play with him and it ended up in quite a little row I…
